data.body: Implemented the certified autodeploy fix in isolated worktree `.rebar/worktrees/fix-011f-autodeploy`: live backend resolution now prefers a running managed container on the nginx live port before consulting HostConfig fallback, and retire sweep retains only the resolved live identity so exited historical port-collision containers can be reaped. Added regression coverage for the 8092 -> 8093 -> 8092 ping-pong and for preserving the genuinely-dead-live-backend fallback marker. Validation: RED-first ping-pong regression failed before the fix with `mcp-live-backend-down`; after fix `pytest tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py -q` passed 63 tests, focused regressions passed 2 tests, and `make check` passed. No commit or push performed.
